sourceRefs.locator: ER 1931, Gregory IX.40, text and Discussion: the clerics’ mission probably in 568, Eufronius of Tours, and the reception in Poitiers in 569.

summary.de: Als Bischof von Tours brachte er auf Wunsch Sigiberts mit seinem Klerus die Reliquien in Radegundes Kloster in Poitiers.
summary.en: As bishop of Tours he accompanied his clergy when they installed the relics at Radegund’s convent in Poitiers at Sigibert’s request.
